units.left_text: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
units.right_text: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:

units.left_text: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
units.right_text: How long, O LORD, must I call for help

units.left_text: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
units.right_text: Why do You make me see iniquity?

units.left_text: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.
units.right_text: Therefore the law is paralyzed,

units.left_text: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.
units.right_text: “Look at the nations and observe—

units.left_text: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.
units.right_text: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans —

units.left_text: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
units.right_text: They are dreaded and feared;

units.left_text: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
units.right_text: Their horses are swifter than leopards,

units.left_text: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.
units.right_text: All of them come bent on violence;

units.left_text: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.
units.right_text: They scoff at kings

units.left_text: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”
units.right_text: Then they sweep by like the wind

units.left_text: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
units.right_text: Are You not from everlasting,

units.left_text: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
units.right_text: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil,

units.left_text: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?
units.right_text: You have made men like the fish of the sea,

units.left_text: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
units.right_text: The foe pulls all of them up with a hook;

units.left_text: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.
units.right_text: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet

units.left_text: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
units.right_text: Will he, therefore, empty his net

units.left_text: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
units.right_text: I will stand at my guard post

units.left_text: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
units.right_text: Then the LORD answered me:

units.left_text: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
units.right_text: For the vision awaits an appointed time;

units.left_text: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
units.right_text: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright —

units.left_text: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.
units.right_text: and wealth indeed betrays him.

units.left_text: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’
units.right_text: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him,

units.left_text: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
units.right_text: Will not your creditors suddenly arise

units.left_text: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.
units.right_text: Because you have plundered many nations,

units.left_text: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
units.right_text: Woe to him who builds his house

units.left_text: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.
units.right_text: You have plotted shame for your house

units.left_text: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.
units.right_text: For the stones will cry out from the wall,

units.left_text: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!
units.right_text: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed

units.left_text: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
units.right_text: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts

units.left_text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
units.right_text: For the earth will be filled

units.left_text: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!
units.right_text: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors,

units.left_text: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
units.right_text: You will be filled with shame instead of glory.

units.left_text: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.
units.right_text: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you,

units.left_text: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?
units.right_text: What use is an idol,

units.left_text: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.
units.right_text: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’

units.left_text: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
units.right_text: But the LORD is in His holy temple;

units.left_text: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
units.right_text: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:

units.left_text: LORD, I have heard of your fame.
units.right_text: O LORD, I have heard the report of You;

units.left_text: God came from Teman,
units.right_text: God came from Teman,

units.left_text: His splendor is like the sunrise.
units.right_text: His radiance was like the sunlight;

units.left_text: Plague went before him,
units.right_text: Plague went before Him,

units.left_text: He stood, and shook the earth.
units.right_text: He stood and measured the earth;

units.left_text: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction.
units.right_text: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress;

units.left_text: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers?
units.right_text: Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD?

units.left_text: You uncovered your bow.
units.right_text: You brandished Your bow;

units.left_text: The mountains saw you, and were afraid.
units.right_text: The mountains saw You and quaked;

units.left_text: The sun and moon stood still in the sky
units.right_text: Sun and moon stood still

units.left_text: You marched through the land in wrath.
units.right_text: You marched across the earth with fury;

units.left_text: You went out for the salvation of your people,
units.right_text: You went forth for the salvation of Your people,

units.left_text: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears.
units.right_text: With his own spear You pierced his head,

units.left_text: You trampled the sea with your horses,
units.right_text: You trampled the sea with Your horses,

units.left_text: I heard, and my body trembled.
units.right_text: I heard and trembled within;

units.left_text: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish,
units.right_text: Though the fig tree does not bud

units.left_text: yet I will rejoice in the LORD.
units.right_text: yet I will exult in the LORD;

units.left_text: GOD, the Lord, is my strength.
units.right_text: GOD the Lord is my strength;
